description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_DoctypeRegistry, which manages a registry of document type definitions (doctype objects). It provides methods to register, retrieve, and manipulate doctypes, including handling aliases and creating doctypes from configurations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DoctypeRegistry
classes.description: A registry class for managing HTML doctype objects, supporting registration, lookup, alias management, and doctype creation based on configurations.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new doctype into the registry, accepting either a doctype object or parameters to construct one, and sets up aliases.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a doctype object by name, resolving aliases, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates a clone of a doctype based on a configuration object, initializing it for use.

methods.name: getDoctypeFromConfig
methods.description: Extracts the doctype string from a configuration object, with support for defaults and compatibility options.
